name: 🌀 Obby But You're Lagging (IMPOSSIBLE)😭
desc:
Welcome to the most chaotic obby experience you've ever played — but there's a twist... you’re lagging!
🧠 Can you adapt to the delay and beat all 60 challenging levels?
💥 Dodge obstacles, time your jumps, and embrace the chaos!
🚧 Still in development — expect bugs, updates, and improvements as we continue to build!

🔔 NEW UPDATE!
🆕 Added 10 new chaotic levels (now 60 total!)
🌈 Reach the end to unlock the R A I N B O W Carpet reward!
